about: Trail and river lines picked by hand: the exact official layer + filter for one POTA park (outside research bot, round 6, Oct 25 2026; checked by chat 2). kpc_state_trails.py draws these first, whatever the name. NOT SURE rows keep their note. Oct 26 (round 11, HQ): + 16 National Historic Trails from NPS National Trails (one layer per trail, so the whole layer is the trail; 5 have no name field: Oregon, California, Pony Express, Mormon Pioneer, El Camino Real de los Tejas). Ala Kahakai is a corridor polygon: in the US key instead.
